How this corpus was built

The latest Nexis pass sent 142 codebook phrases and stored 135 new United States documents. 445 hits were already saved, and 1225 were outside the United States.

  1. 1 · Collect

    Archive pages and Nexis hits are stored together in data/news.sqlite. Identical headlines share one row, so the count above is one row per story.

  2. 2 · Search the codebook

    Each measure name, quoted definition term, and example phrase is searched with the routing-app group. United States hits are kept.

  3. 3 · Label by phrase

    280 documents contain at least one codebook phrase. 1325 do not, so they stay unlabeled.

  4. 4 · Qualitative categories

    1605 documents also have a qualitative category, place, and summary, assigned from what each article says. The other 0 are marked Unlabeled on the map.

What was done

The map reads every saved document. Qualitative categories cover 1605 of them, assigned from what each article says. Phrase labels come from sheet 1012_codebook and do not replace those coded fields. 1325 documents never used a codebook phrase.

  1. 1. URL lists were fetched into the archive. Nexis was searched with the saved United States overview query, then again with each codebook phrase plus the routing-app group.
  2. 2. United States hits were saved. Hits from outside the United States were counted and skipped. A document already on disk was not stored twice.
  3. 3. Identical headlines were combined. All remaining documents were written to crawled_documents in data/news.sqlite.
  4. 4. Phrase labeling checks the measure name, quoted definition terms, and example phrases. A miss stays unlabeled. It is not forced into a category.
  5. 5. 1605 documents have a qualitative category, governing level, place, and summary taken from the article. Those fields are kept. The other 0 appear as Unlabeled.

Where the files live

Pipeline Stage Tool / Model / Engine Primary Function Key Implementation File
Commercial News Search LexisNexis Web Services API (REST) Retrieves full-text licensed news reporting across U.S. national and local news wires. news_importer/nexis.py
Web Archival Scraping Crawl4AI + Async Headless Browser Renders municipal council portals, public comment PDFs, and local greenway plans. news_importer/crawl.py
Wire Normalization & Dedup Regex Wire Normalizer (`normalize_title_for_dedup`) Strips wire syndicate tags and punctuation, collapsing over 50 regional duplicates. news_importer/crawl_nexis_us.py
Data Storage & Lineage SQLite 3 (`data/news.sqlite`) Holds the URL importer tables and the crawled_documents table used by this page. news_importer/db.py
Evidence Verification Verbatim Passage Validator (`verify_passage`) Checks that a coded quotation appears in the saved text. news_importer/analysis.py

One example, from search to coded row

Leonia, New Jersey closed streets to non-local drivers after navigation apps sent traffic through town. These are the query, the saved hit, and the coded row.

Search terms Taxonomy Design

Initial research objective: capture municipal ordinances blocking commuter shortcut traffic. Expanded into mandatory app groups and Boolean proximity blocks:

( "cut-through traffic" OR "through traffic" OR "shortcut traffic" OR "rat running" OR "residential streets" )
AND ( complaint OR complaints OR backlash OR opposition OR petition OR "public comment" )
AND ( ( law OR ordinance OR ban OR regulation ) W/20 ( routing OR navigation OR traffic OR streets ) )
Overview query sent to Nexis queries/nexis_us_overview_query.txt (US-OVERVIEW-01)
( Waze OR "Google Maps" OR "Apple Maps" OR MapQuest OR "HERE WeGo" OR "navigation app" OR "routing app" ) AND ( ( "road access" OR "turn restriction" OR "road closure" OR "resident only" OR "no through traffic" OR "traffic calming" OR "traffic diverter" OR "congestion pricing" OR ( ( law OR ordinance OR ban ) W/20 ( routing OR navigation OR traffic ) ) ) OR ( "routing policy" OR "routing algorithm" OR "avoid residential streets" OR "eco-friendly routing" ) OR ( "Waze for Cities" OR "Connected Citizens Program" OR ( ( partnership OR "data sharing" ) W/20 ( government OR city OR "transportation department" ) ) ) )
